tip.presetJoint: Two planetary stages, 12.884:1: 9.8 N*m at 247 rpm at the output.
tip.add_planetary: Simple planetary stage: sun, planets, ring.
tip.add_compound_planetary: Stepped-planet planetary stage: second planet gear meshes with the ring.
tip.stageName: Stage names must be unique; the stage keeps its identity when renamed or moved.
tip.nPlanets: Number of planets. Equal spacing needs (sun + ring teeth) divisible by this number.
tip.fixedMember: The member held still; the input is the sun and the output the carrier.
tip.bearingSlot: Bearing from the catalogue (only cards the core can rate). Without bearings no bearing life is calculated.
tip.preset: The acceptance preset: safety-factor limits, required life and duty shape. All its values are proposals awaiting confirmation.
tip.lubricant: Catalogue lubricant. Grease is rated by its base oil only.
tip.torqueAt: Which shaft the torque is applied to.
tip.direction: Forward: power from input to output. Reverse: power back-driven from the output.
tip.tab_point: One operating point: torque, speed, efficiency both ways, safety factors, bearings, lubrication.
tip.tab_spectrum: Duty spectrum: life by Palmgren-Miner, preset checks and the peak event.
tip.tab_assembly: 3-D assembly of all stages; the rotation follows the pose calculation.
tip.stages: Stages in order from the input; each stage's output is the next stage's input.
tip.limitations: What this screening calculation does not cover. Read it before using any number.
tip.pass: Combined result of the overall state, the preset checks and every supplied part. Estimated results may pass their thresholds but stay labelled as estimates.
tip.endurance: Zero damage in the supported model. This is not unlimited physical life.
tip.bearingDiagnostic: The bearing record failed or is unsupported: its life is a diagnostic value, not a rating, and no aggregate bearing life is formed.
tip.boundary: Boundary lubrication: the oil film is thinner than the surface roughness; wear and micropitting risk is high.
tip.missingInputs: Inputs the calculation needed and did not have. Results that depend on them are unavailable or estimated.
tip.sf: Tooth-root bending safety factor (ISO 6336-3). A dash means it could not be calculated.
tip.l10h: Basic rating life (ISO 281) at this point.
tip.s0: Static safety factor of the bearing (ISO 76).
tip.eta: Dynamic viscosity of the oil or grease base oil at the working temperature.
tip.lambda: Specific film thickness; below 1 the surfaces touch.
tip.mechanism: Failure mechanism summed over the spectrum.
tip.damage: Palmgren-Miner damage sum over the required life.
tip.life: Life in hours at the spectrum.
tip.effForward: Efficiency when the input drives the output.
tip.effReverse: Efficiency when the output drives the input (back-driving).
tip.backlash: Angular backlash at the output from the tooth-thickness allowances.
tip.stiffness: Mesh stiffness only; shafts, pins and housing are not included.
tip.envDiameter: Largest diameter including the full planet orbit; no housing.
tip.envLength: Axial length of all stages and gaps.
tip.gearLife: Shortest gear life over all members.
tip.bearingLife: Aggregate life of all bearings; not formed when any bearing record failed.
tip.binHours: Duration of the bin in the required-life block.
tip.peakTorque: Peak torque at the output for the static check.
tip.peakEvents: Number of peak events over the life.
tip.peakSpeed: Output speed during a peak event; zero is allowed.
tip.inputAngle: Rotation angle at the chain input; every gear and planet orbit follows from the pose calculation.
tip.title: Gear and planetary gearbox calculation: a screening estimate, not a qualification.
tip.noVerdict: A single operating point is never a duty qualification: parts and the preset are not evaluated here, so the point carries no pass or fail. The reasons below say what is missing. Use the duty spectrum for the verdict.
tip.showStages: Which stages are shown in the 3-D view.
tip.saved: Gearboxes saved on the server: the design, the operating point or duty spectrum, and the last result when it is current.
tip.project: Project id the record belongs to; blank keeps it in the workspace. There is no access rule yet: the page is staff only.
tip.saveNew: Save the current design as a new record.
tip.saveChanges: Overwrite the open record. It is refused when somebody saved a newer version meanwhile.
tip.showArchived: Archived records are kept; show them to restore one.
tip.unreadable: Files in this scope that could not be read. They are not listed; ask an administrator to check them.
tip.tab_motor: The gearbox behind a motor: required motor torque and speed, losses, margin against the motor's saved points, chain efficiency and torque per mass. Saved results only; nothing is solved.
tip.motorDie: Motors you may see. Only saved operating points are used.
tip.gearboxSource: The current design as edited, or the saved record that is open in Saved gearboxes.
tip.loadRows: Output torque and speed per mode. A mode is answered by the motor's saved duty: continuous by its rated duty, peak by a short-time duty.
tip.loadName: Mode name: continuous or peak map to saved duties by themselves; any other name needs a duty.
tip.loadTorque: Torque required at the gearbox output.
tip.loadSpeed: Speed required at the gearbox output.
tip.loadDuty: Saved duty of the motor that answers this row. Automatic uses the rule for the mode.
tip.covered: Both the torque and the speed the gearbox needs from the motor are within the one saved motor point. Between saved points nothing is claimed.
tip.limitedBy: What the saved motor point cannot deliver. The requirement is shown as is, never clamped.
tip.motoringOnly: Power flows from the motor to the load. Regeneration and back-driving are not computed.
tip.reverseNotComputed: The reverse (back-drive) direction of the chain is not computed here.
tip.dtLimitations: What the drivetrain check does not cover.
tip.partialLoss: Some losses were not computed (missing inputs: {missing}); the total holds only what was computed.
tip.dtRequired: What the output point needs from the motor through the gearbox.
tip.dtSaved: The motor's saved operating point of the matching duty.
tip.dtMargin: Saved minus required; negative means the saved point is short.
tip.dtBearings: Bearing friction loss. A dash means no bearing was supplied: not computed, not zero.
tip.dtChurning: Churning and drag loss. A dash means no drag torque was supplied: not computed, not zero.
tip.dtEffGearbox: Gearbox efficiency at the required point.
tip.dtEffMotor: The motor's saved efficiency, at its own saved torque and speed.
tip.dtEffChain: Motor times gearbox, given only when the required point matches the saved motor point within 2 %.

stateTip.estimated: Calculated with simplified factors or assumed inputs; it may pass a threshold but stays an estimate.
stateTip.unsupported: The model does not cover this case: no value or no valid value. It can never pass.
stateTip.failed: Calculated, and it does not meet the requirement or a model check failed.

viewerLost: The 3-D view lost its graphics context. Reload the page to continue.

reasonTip.overall_state: The worst state over all stages.
reasonTip.part: A supplied part (shaft, pin, carrier, rim, key) or a gear tooth failed or is unsupported.
reasonTip.parts_not_passed: At least one part does not pass.
reasonTip.parts_not_evaluated: A single operating point does not evaluate parts. Use the duty spectrum.
reasonTip.preset_not_evaluated: A single operating point does not evaluate the preset. Use the duty spectrum.
reasonTip.preset: A preset threshold is not met or could not be evaluated.

why.unsupported_or_missing_input: Unsupported by the model or an input is missing.
why.requires_spectrum_evaluation: Only the duty spectrum calculates this.

limit.internalRoot: Internal gear (ring) root bending is unsupported
limit.outOfDomain: Stress above the S-N plateau is out of domain
limit.unqualifiedModels: Several models are not independently qualified
limit.estimates: Material cards, lubrication and thermal inputs are estimates
limit.forces: Shaft and housing mechanics are simplified
limit.bearingAggregate: Failed bearing records give no aggregate life

limitTip.internalRoot: Root bending of the internal gear (including cutter-count-only inputs) and thin-rim gates are not supported. A planetary life or qualification cannot be green while a required root or history is unavailable.
limitTip.reversal: Signed reversal and contact-history fatigue are not supported. Simple-planet peak screening uses the worse mesh stress and does not resolve the alternating two-flank history. Endurance means unlimited only inside the supported Miner and S-N model, never unlimited physical life.
limitTip.staticAllowables: Static tooth-root and hardened-flank safety needs provenanced allowables at the matching temperature; fatigue plateaux and core yield are no substitute. Static screening domain: pressure angle 15 to 25 degrees, helix up to 30 degrees, transverse contact ratio 1 to 2.5, plus the geometry and root gates.
limitTip.outOfDomain: Stress above a static S-N plateau is outside the model: no one-cycle extrapolation is made, so capacity, damage and life stay unavailable.
limitTip.helicalYF: The helical tooth-form factor load-point interpolation is not verified against ISO 6336-3:2019.
limitTip.unqualifiedModels: Mesh-loss correlation, bearing friction and ISO 281, K_v, K_Hbeta, K_Halpha, Y_beta, internal geometry, shaft factors, carrier, pin and rim checks, thermal balance, stiffness, mass, inertia, drivetrain export and CAD outlines lack complete independent literature or measured qualification.
limitTip.estimates: Generic material cards and ISO factor estimates, grease and contact-temperature assumptions, preload and thermal heat transfer are estimates. A passing preset is screening with the supplied modelled parts; omitted optional parts are not a mechanical certification. Missing support and static inputs stay visible.
limitTip.forces: Forces use nominal equal branch vectors and adversely aligned external loads; unequal branches, general seats, overhangs, overturning and housing mechanics are not modelled. Oil churning reaction is estimated. Missing mesh efficiency gives an unavailable efficiency.
limitTip.bearingAggregate: A failed or unsupported bearing spectrum gives no aggregate life; finite life values inside failed records are diagnostic only. Blank bounds exclude the housing.
limitTip.outlines: Sampled or decimated outlines are viewer geometry, not manufacturing CAD and not a 3-D clearance certification.
limitTip.irMotoringOnly: The drivetrain (TransmissionIR) export from the core is motoring only and keeps partial and unqualified provenance. This page does not use it.

noVerdict: Point: no verdict (run the duty spectrum for a pass / fail)
bearingFit: Bearing does not fit inside the planet (OD {od} mm, max {max} mm)

flagTip.response_stale: The saved result may no longer be trusted, so it is not shown on Open; calculate again.
flagTip.request_hash_mismatch: The stored request does not match its stored hash.
flagTip.request_invalid: The core no longer accepts the stored request.
flagTip.checksum_mismatch: The file was changed outside the application (torn or hand-edited).
flagTip.core_stale: The calculation core changed since the result was saved.
flagTip.catalogue_changed: Materials, lubricants, bearings or presets changed since the result was saved.

unreadable: {count, plural, one {# unreadable file} other {# unreadable files}}

basisTip.shaft: The saved result carries the shaft-torque convention marker: the torque is the marked shaft quantity.
basisTip.field_legacy: The saved result predates the shaft convention: the torque is the electromagnetic field torque, which can differ from the shaft torque.

dtStatusTip.ok: Calculated from the motor's saved point.
dtStatusTip.missing: The motor has no usable saved point for this row; the reason is shown. The gearbox side is still calculated.
dtStatusTip.gearbox_failed: The core marks the gearbox failed at this point; its state and missing inputs are shown. No comparison with the motor is made.

dtMissing.shaft_key_unrecognised: The saved result is marked as shaft-based but has no recognised shaft torque.

dtMissingTip.shaft_key_unrecognised: A marked saved result states shaft quantities. Its shaft torque key is not one this page knows, so the field torque is deliberately not used. Re-save the motor result.

dtReason.motor_point_differs: The required motor point is not the saved one (more than 2 % apart): no chain number is given; the two efficiencies are shown separately.
dtReason.no_saved_point: The motor has no saved point for this row.
dtReason.not_covered: The saved motor point does not cover the requirement.
dtReason.efficiency_unavailable: The saved result has no efficiency.
dtReason.gearbox_failed: The gearbox failed at this point.
